# UI HUB

> Free open-source React UI components, animation effects, WebGL 3D backgrounds, and website templates built for vibe coding with AI coding assistants (Cursor, Claude Code, Google Antigravity, Lovable).

UI HUB (https://www.uihub.codes/) provides production-ready React components with full TypeScript source code, Tailwind CSS styling, documented props, and copy-and-paste prompts for AI developer tools. Every component is released under the MIT license.

## Core Navigation

- [Website Home](https://www.uihub.codes/): Overview of UI HUB component catalog, featured components, and live demos.
- [Component Library](https://www.uihub.codes/library): Interactive component studio with live preview tuning, prop explorer, and code export.
- [Website Templates](https://www.uihub.codes/templates): 21 full website templates with video previews, code viewers, and AI vibe prompts.
- [Build with UI HUB](https://www.uihub.codes/build-with-ui-hub): Section-level layouts (Heroes, Showcases, Footers) for rapid landing page assembly.

## Component Categories

- [Interactive Backgrounds](https://www.uihub.codes/components/interactive-background): Cursor- and pointer-reactive backgrounds (Magnetic, Wave Tunnel, Aura, Black Hole).
- [3D Effects](https://www.uihub.codes/components/3d): WebGL, Three.js, and Spline 3D scenes (Rubiks Cube, 3D Slider, Space Background).
- [Cursor Effects](https://www.uihub.codes/components/cursor): Custom reactive pointer components (Target Cursor, Magnetic Cursor, Lizard, Heart).
- [Website Backgrounds](https://www.uihub.codes/components/background): Full-bleed landing page backgrounds (Isometric Grid, Aurora, Gradient Mesh).
- [Animated Text](https://www.uihub.codes/components/text): Kinetic typography (ScrambleText, RotatingText, DotsToSolidText, TextPath).
- [UI Effects](https://www.uihub.codes/components/effect): Micro-interactions and hover mechanics (Cards Beam, Spotlight, Border Beam, Kinetic Grid).
- [Buttons](https://www.uihub.codes/components/button): Call-to-action buttons (Venom Button, Spider Button, Corner Button).
- [Navigation Bars](https://www.uihub.codes/components/navbar): Responsive headers, glassmorphism navbars, and mobile menus.
- [Footers](https://www.uihub.codes/components/footer): Modern landing page footers (Segmint Footer, DontBeGreedy Footer, Sora Footer).
- [Scroll Animations](https://www.uihub.codes/components/scroll): Scroll-driven parallax, sticky sections, and timeline reveals (Atelier Drift, Mostar Cinematic).
- [Image Interactions](https://www.uihub.codes/components/image-interaction): 3D tilt cards, cursor image trails, and distortion ripple effects.
- [Loaders](https://www.uihub.codes/components/loader): Preloaders, progress counters, and geometric loading spinners (Cube Loaders).
- [Forms](https://www.uihub.codes/components/form): Interactive input fields, focus effects, and animated form layouts.
- [Particle Backgrounds](https://www.uihub.codes/components/particles-background): GPU-rendered particle fields and spheres (ParticleSphere, NeonRain, Sparkles).
- [Space Animations](https://www.uihub.codes/components/space): Solar system simulations, planetary physics, and orbital WebGL experiences (Solar System, Saturn, Moon, Mars).
- [Community Components](https://www.uihub.codes/components/custom): Community-contributed React components and experimentations (open for submissions).

## Integration & Installation

All components use standard React and Tailwind CSS. Common animation and physics dependencies include:

```bash
# Framer Motion (micro-interactions & layout animations)
npm install framer-motion clsx tailwind-merge lucide-react

# GSAP (timeline & scroll-driven animations)
npm install gsap @gsap/react

# Three.js (3D & WebGL rendering)
npm install three @types/three @react-three/fiber @react-three/drei
```

## AI Coding Tool Compatibility

Each component page provides 5 curated AI vibe prompts designed for instant code generation:
- **Advance:** Master format with complete TypeScript blueprint, props, gotchas, and full source.
- **Antigravity:** Explicit scoped constraints for Google Antigravity / Gemini CLI.
- **Claude Code:** Structural deconstruction with single-file mandate for Anthropic Claude.
- **Cursor:** Concise typed prompt for Cursor IDE composer and inline edits.
- **Lovable:** Visual behavior and responsiveness prompt for Lovable web app builder.
